The ways of preservation of roughage - general principles. Preservation by silage making. Ensilability of forage. Influence of technology factors on fermentation process and silage quality. Silage preservatives and their use. Fermentation stages of silages. Mass and nutrient losses. Secondary stability of silages. Silage juices, influence on environment and the ways of liquidation. Silos and clamp construction. Ensiling into big bales and into foil-wrapped bales. Evaluation quality of silages. Ensiling of the main kinds of forages and remainders from the food industry. Storage of silages and risk of devaluation during storage. Storage of dry roughages -- hay, straw and root crops. Requirements on warehouse and storage technique. Postharwest fermentation of hay, selfheating and selfignition. Storage losses and risk of feeds devaluation. Roughages processing. Chemical and biological treatment of roughages. (allowance 24/24)

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The course provides theoretical fundamentals of preservation and storage of forage, storage treatment and ways of preparation before feeding.

Evaluation quality of silages. Ensiling of the main kinds of forages and remainders from the food industry. Storage of silages and risk of devaluation during storage.
